spans.s:
mfn. (-न्दन्-न्दती-न्दत्)
Breaking, destroying.
E.
भिद to break, शतृ aff.

m. (-लः)
A short arrow thrown from the hand, or shot through a tube.

mfn. (-न्नः-न्ना-न्नं)
1 Split, broken, torn, rent.
2 Divided, distinguished, other, different.
3 Separated, detached.
4 Blown, budded, opened.
5 Neglected, deviated from.
6 Connected, joined.
m. (-न्नः)
A flaw in a jewel.
n. (-न्नं)
1 A bit, a portion.
2 (In arithmetic,) A fraction.
E.
भिद to break, to divide, aff. क्त.

m. (-कः)
A heterodox sectary, a Bauddha, a seceder.
E.
भिन्न broken, separated, and कन् aff.

f. (-का)
A kind of cucumber, (Cucumis utilatissimus.)
E.
भिन्न divided, गात्र the body, aff. of comparison कन्.

n. (-नं)
Multiplication of fractions.
E.
भिन्न, and गुणन multiplying.

n. (-नं)
Cube of a fraction.
E.
भिन्न, and घन a cube.

mfn. (-हः-हा-हं)
Wounded.
E.
भिन्न, and देह body.

mfn. (-कः-का-कं)
Wrecked.
E.
भिन्न, and नौका a ship.

m. (-रः)
Division of fractions.
E.
भिन्न, and भागहर division.

n. (-ण्डं)
A potsherd, a broken plate or vessel.
E.
भिन्न, and भाण्ड a vessel.

mfn. (-र्म्मा-र्म्मा-र्म्म)
Pierced in the joints, mortally wounded.
E.
भिन्न, and मर्म्मन् a joint.

mfn. (-वान्-वती-वत्)
Divided, scattered.
E.
भिद to break, क्तवतु aff.

m. (-र्गः)
Square of a fraction.
E.
भिन्न, and बर्ग a square.

mfn. (-त्तिः-त्तिः-त्ति)
1 Neglecting the prescribed observances.
2 Following an occupation not suited to birth or caste.
E.
भिन्न, and वृत्ति practice.

n. (-तं)
Subtraction of fractions.
E.
भिन्न, and व्यवकलित subtraction; also भिन्नव्यवकलनं, &c.

n. (-तं)
Addition of fractions.
E.
भिन्न, and सङ्कलित addition; also भिन्नसङ्कलनं, &c.

mfn. (-रः-रा-रं)
1 Hesitating (in speech.)
2 Hoarse, discordant.
E.
भिन्न, and स्वर a note.
